comp-k1xv5euf wixui-rich-text" data-testid="richTextElement"><h2 class="font_2 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:36px; line-height:1.4em;"><span style="font-size:36px;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-weight:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-family:signika,sans-serif;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="letter-spacing:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">Villa Pefkakia The kite house</span></span></span></span></h2></div><div id="comp-k1xv5eut" class="N8MGzv _v6ohL AWXfZq PO9MfV comp-k1xv5eut wixui-rich-text" data-testid="richTextElement"><p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:20px;"><span style="font-size:20px;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">Villa Pefkakia is a small family-run guesthouse designed for people who love wind, sea and simple island life.</span></p>

<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:20px;"><span style="font-size:20px;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">Perched on the hill above the lagoon of Agios Nikolaos, Lefkada, the house offers a stunning view of the water and the kite spot.</span></p>

<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:20px;"><span style="font-size:20px;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">Here you will find a relaxed atmosphere, a friendly environment and a perfect location for your kitesurf holiday in Lefkada.</span></p>

<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:20px;"><span style="font-size:20px;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">Our rooms are simple, comfortable and perfect for travelers who come to Lefkada for kitesurfing and the sea.</span></p>

<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:20px;"><span style="font-size:20px;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">Located just a few minutes from the lagoon of Agios Nikolaos, Lefkada, the house offers a peaceful place to relax after a day on the water.</span></p>

<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:20px;"><span style="font-size:20px;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">Guests can enjoy the terrace, the garden and the beautiful view over the lagoon.</span></p></div><div class="comp-mmhkoqnj mu5PoX" id="comp-mmhkoqnj" aria-disabled="false"><a data-testid="linkElement" href="https://www.kitesurfagiosnikolaos.com/booking-request" target="_self" class="twJknM wixui-button ZhVEJq" aria-disabled="false" aria-label="Booking request"><span class="OR4Nv8 wixui-button__label">Booking request</span></a></div></div></div></section><section id="comp-lhx881ge" tabindex="-1" class="Le88gL comp-lhx881ge wixui-section" data-block-level-container="ClassicSection"><div
